```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nichenetr)
library(multinichenetr)
```


## Fig 6A - multinichenet circoplot

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r MNN for CD8}
multinichenet_output = readRDS("~/R/MNN_BCA_tumorvsLN_final_output.rds")

sample_id = "sample_id"
group_id = "tissue"
celltype_id = "All.Cell.Types"

covariates = NA 
batches = NA 

contrasts_oi = c("'tumor-LN','LN-tumor'")
contrast_tbl = tibble(contrast =
                        c("tumor-LN", "LN-tumor"),
                      group = c("tumor", "LN"))
logFC_threshold = 0.50
p_val_adj = TRUE
p_val_threshold = 0.05
fraction_cutoff = 0.05
top_n_target = 250




### load nichenet models ligand-receptor rds
lr_network_all = readRDS("~/R/lr_network_human_allInfo_30112033.rds") %>% mutate(ligand = convert_alias_to_symbols(ligand, organism = "human"), receptor = convert_alias_to_symbols(receptor, organism = "human"))
lr_network_all = lr_network_all  %>% mutate(ligand = make.names(ligand), receptor = make.names(receptor)) 
lr_network = lr_network_all %>% distinct(ligand, receptor)

ligand_target_matrix = readRDS("~/R/ligand_target_matrix_nsga2r_final.rds")
colnames(ligand_target_matrix) = colnames(ligand_target_matrix) %>% convert_alias_to_symbols(organism = "human") %>% make.names()
rownames(ligand_target_matrix) = rownames(ligand_target_matrix) %>% convert_alias_to_symbols(organism = "human") %>% make.names()
lr_network = lr_network %>% filter(ligand %in% colnames(ligand_target_matrix))
ligand_target_matrix = ligand_target_matrix[, lr_network$ligand %>% unique()]


## set celltypes

celltypes_oi = multinichenet_output$celltype_de$cluster_id %>% unique() %>% sort()


## set colors
colors_sender = c(
  "CD8.T"="#12448F",
  "CD4.CD8.T"="#0078B7",
  "CD4.T"="#307153",
  "CD4.Treg"="#B9DCC4",
  "CD4.Tfh.like"="#52B689",
  "T.misc"="#98CEB0",
  "Plasma.B.cell" ="#D80F16",
  "B.cell"="#db4f37",
  "CD16..NK" ="#F28B0D",
  "NK"="#E75E0D",
  "ILC"="#FBB914",
  "Mast.cell"="#E6CBB1",
  "cDC2" = "#D7E293",
  "cDC1"= "#E8E230",
  "migDC" ="#7EB928",
  "Macrophage" = "#644193",
  "pDC" = "#A4173D",
  "CD14..Monocyte"= "#EA4E6E",
  "CD16..Monocyte"= "#EE738F",
  "MoDC"  = "#E72270",
  "Myeloid.misc" = "#C1B3D8",
  "Stromal.cell" = "#472C20",
  "Proliferating"= "#AF8968",
  "Cycling" = "#BDBDBD"
)

colors_receiver = colors_sender


## Myeloid cells vs CD8
myeloid_cells = c("migDC", "cDC2", "CD14..Monocyte", "pDC", "MoDC", "CD16..Monocyte", "Macrophage", "cDC1")
lymphoid_cells = c("CD8.T")

###### circolpot top 200 --> CD69 interacting with LGALS1 macrophage cDC2 and MoDC
prioritized_tbl_oi_all_combined = get_top_n_lr_pairs(
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables, 
  top_n = 200,  # default 2000
  rank_per_group = FALSE, 
  senders_oi = union(myeloid_cells, lymphoid_cells), 
  receivers_oi = union(myeloid_cells, lymphoid_cells)
)

##
# CD8 als reciever cell
prioritized_tbl_oi_all = prioritized_tbl_oi_all_combined %>% filter(sender %in% myeloid_cells & receiver %in% lymphoid_cells )
prioritized_tbl_oi = 
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl %>%
  filter(id %in% prioritized_tbl_oi_all$id) %>%
  distinct(id, sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, group) %>% 
  left_join(prioritized_tbl_oi_all)
prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score[is.na(prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score)] = 0

circos_list = make_circos_group_comparison(prioritized_tbl_oi, colors_sender, colors_receiver)

```

## Fig 6B - pseudobulk L-R expression per patient per tissue for CD69 - LGALS1
```{r multinichenet}
myeloid_cells = c("cDC1", "cDC2", "MoDC", "Macrophage")
lymphoid_cells = c( "CD8.T")
group_oi = "tumor"
prioritized_tbl_oi_tumor_all = get_top_n_lr_pairs(
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables, 
  100, 
  groups_oi = group_oi, 
  receivers_oi = union(myeloid_cells, lymphoid_cells),
  senders_oi = union(myeloid_cells, lymphoid_cells)
) 

prioritized_tbl_oi_tumor = prioritized_tbl_oi_tumor_all %>% filter(sender %in% myeloid_cells & receiver %in% lymphoid_cells )

plot_oi = make_sample_lr_prod_activity_plots_Omnipath(
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables, 
  prioritized_tbl_oi_tumor %>% inner_join(lr_network_all)
)

plot_oi + ggtitle("Myeloid to Lymphoid - Tumor")
## minimalized in Illustrator

```



## Figure 6C - Violinplots CD69, adt_cd69 and LGALS1
```{r}
VlnPlot(nsclc, 
        'CD69', 
        idents = c("CD8 T", "Macrophage APOE", "MoDC", "cDC2", "cDC1", "migDC"),
        cols = All.Subsets.Col, pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(nsclc, 
        'adt_CD69.1', 
        idents = c("CD8 T", "Macrophage APOE", "MoDC", "cDC2", "cDC1", "migDC"),
        cols = All.Subsets.Col, pt.size = 0)

VlnPlot(nsclc, 
        'LGALS1', 
        idents = c("CD8 T", "Macrophage APOE", "MoDC", "cDC2", "cDC1", "migDC"),
        cols = All.Subsets.Col, pt.size = 0)

```

## Figure S6B - Violinplots and bar graphs of cells expressing >0.01 CD69, PD-1, CTLA4 and TIGIT in CD8 subsets
```{r}
## subset on expression levels >0.01 (= exclude 0)
T8.CD69 <- subset(T8, subset = CD69 > 0.01)

T8.PD1 <-subset(T8, subset = PDCD1 > 0.01)

T8.CTLA4 <-subset(T8, subset = CTLA4 > 0.01)

T8.TIGIT <-subset(T8, subset = TIGIT > 0.01)

VlnPlot(T8.CD69, "CD69", pt.size=0, col = col_T8)

VlnPlot(T8.PD1, "PDCD1", pt.size=0, col = col_T8)

VlnPlot(T8.CTLA4, "CTLA4", pt.size=0, col = col_T8)

VlnPlot(T8.TIGIT, "TIGIT", pt.size=0, col = col_T8)


a<-table(T8.CD69@meta.data$CD8.Cell.Types)
b<-table(T8.PD1@meta.data$CD8.Cell.Types)
c<-table(T8.CTLA4@meta.data$CD8.Cell.Types)
d<-table(T8.TIGIT@meta.data$CD8.Cell.Types)
e<-table(T8@meta.data$CD8.Cell.Types)
ff<-cbind(a,b,c,d,e)
View(ff)
write.csv(ff, 'FigS6.expr_above_0.csv')

# see graphpad FigS6
```
